propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice with hardcoded provider checks and refusals that prevent Bedrock and OpenAI-compatible endpoints from working with full fidelity
AWS Bedrock-hosted Claude requires a native builder and capability-profile override to support prompt caching and structured output, not a gateway-only approach
documented REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY configuration is currently false because _pai_check_config refuses base_url/api_key outright
a provider_factory hook plus per-provider ModelProfile overrides replace inline provider-name matching and enable first-class Bedrock plus best-effort OpenAI-compatible routing
signed verdict sidecars must carry structured provenance including provider, model, endpoint host, and support tier to distinguish first-class from best-effort attestations

Bedrock retry and timeout configuration through botocore is deferred because the current implementation lacks botocore.config.Config and timeout parameters, leaving the unconfigured Bedrock path as production-live
